svg.title: The sum law on a graph
svg.desc: Three curves near x = 2. The crimson curve f approaches 3, the blue curve g approaches -1, and the dashed green curve f + g approaches 2, which is 3 + (-1). A panel lists the laws: as x approaches 2, f(x) approaches 3, g(x) approaches -1, f(x) + g(x) approaches 2, f(x) times g(x) approaches -3, and 5f(x) approaches 15.

text.tspan: Each law turns one hard limit
